title: AssociateFacilityNetworkRequest
description: Request to associate a facility with one or more networks

groupId.description: ID of the group that the network belongs to

networkId.description: Single network ID (legacy). Mutually exclusive with networkIds.

networkIds.description: Bulk network IDs (CP-32346). Mutually exclusive with networkId.

includeAllActiveFacilityLocations.description: When true, associate all active facility locations under the facility/group

facilityLocationIds.description: Certify location IDs to associate (optional when includeAllActiveFacilityLocations is true)

networkEffectiveDate.description: Effective date for facility and location network associations

groupEffectiveDate.description: Effective date for the TenantGroupFacility relationship

networkAssociations.description: Grouped network associations (CP-32346): one entry per network, each with its own effective date. Allows associating multiple networks with different effective dates in a single request. Mutually exclusive with networkId/networkIds.

NetworkAssociationEntry.description: A single network with its own effective date

effectiveDate.description: Effective date applied to this network
